title: Detection of Potato Plant Leaf Diseases using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.20544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Potato is an important food-security crop in Ethiopia, but its production is affected by foliar diseases, particularly early blight and late blight. This study develops a lightweight convolutional neural network (CNN) to classify potato leaves into three categories: healthy, early blight, and late blight. The proposed model was trained using 2,215 images from the PlantVillage dataset and evaluated on an independent field dataset containing 247 images collected from potato farms in Banja, Awi Zone, Ethiopia. On PlantVillage, the model achieved 99.04% training accuracy, 98.21% validation accuracy, and 98.66% test accuracy. On the field dataset, it achieved 90.28% accuracy. The study also compares the proposed CNN with VGG16 and MobileNetV2 in terms of classification performance and computational efficiency. translated_title: 使用卷积神经网络检测马铃薯植物叶片病害
translated_abstract: 马铃薯是埃塞俄比亚重要的粮食安全作物，但其产量受到叶部病害的影响，尤其是早疫病和晚疫病。本研究开发了一个轻量级卷积神经网络（CNN），将马铃薯叶片分为三类：健康、早疫病和晚疫病。所提出的模型使用来自PlantVillage数据集的2,215张图像进行训练，并在一个独立的田间数据集上进行了评估，该数据集包含从埃塞俄比亚Awi Zone Banja地区马铃薯农场收集的247张图像。在PlantVillage数据集上，该模型达到了99.04%的训练准确率、98.21%的验证准确率和98.66%的测试准确率；在田间数据集上达到了90.28%的准确率。该研究还在分类性能和计算效率方面将所提出的CNN与VGG16和MobileNetV2进行了比较。所提出的模型包含446,787个可训练参数，占用约1.70 MB存储空间，平均处理每张图像需要5.58秒。
tldr: 本研究开发了一种仅含446,787个参数（约1.70 MB）的轻量级CNN模型，在PlantVillage数据集上达到98.66%的测试准确率，并在埃塞俄比亚独立田间数据集上达到90.28%的准确率，可用于检测马铃薯早疫病和晚疫病。
en_tdlr: This study develops a lightweight CNN with only 446,787 trainable parameters (~1.70 MB) that achieves 98.66% test accuracy on the PlantVillage dataset and 90.28% accuracy on an independent Ethiopian field dataset for classifying potato leaves as healthy, early blight, or late blight.
